svg.title: What do the hooks do around the agent's work?

g.text: What do the hooks do around the agent's work?
Claude Code and Codex: a new session, a clear, a compaction or a resume
or the newest plans and handoffs
[a gate bypass, any push or publish,
a gh command that is not read or
local, or one that prints the token
Claude Code: after a shell command fails
on a C or C++ file
When the agent ends its turn: Claude Code and Codex (step log), Claude Code (claim check)
tests or say they were not
